title: Three Winters and One Short Ledger
subtitle: 经济人生 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济人生（人与社会·商业与经济·财富与命运）
meta: 主题语境：经济人生（人与社会·商业与经济·财富与命运）　|　核心词汇：fortune　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fortune 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my grandfather ① made a fortune that no clerk in the town would have counted, and he said the making was the whole of the winter. The ② fortune, meaning the money itself and not the luck, ran three winters and stayed uncounted in the book; a fortune, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ fortune in that town had the same short ledger beside it, and the ④ fortune at the far counter, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A fortune, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; my grandfather said the counting is the part that fills three winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the fortune was the whole of the matter, meaning the chance and not the money. The ⑥ fortune, meaning the chance and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; fortune, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both money and a chance. He said the chance is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ fortune had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short ledger. The ⑧ fortune of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in January, was one town and three winters of counting; fortune, he said, is either the one at the far counter or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ fortune I remember is the one counted in the plan, which closed in 1974 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ fortune, my mother said in 1976, is the only one that improves by being counted; every fortune, she said, is a chance that has agreed to look like money. She said the chance was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 财富；财产（指镇上每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 财富（指那一笔本身，与运气相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a fortune 挣得一笔财富
D. n. 财富（指留给孩子们的那一笔）
E. n. 财富（抽象总称，指一个镇上的聚财之事）
F. n. 财富（指计划里写到、被清点过的那一笔）
G. n. 运气；机遇（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 运气（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: made a fortune that no clerk in the town would have counted
The fortune, meaning the money itself and not the luck
the fortune at the far counter
the fortune was the whole of the matter
the fortune had become a line in a plan
The fortune of the whole thing
A fortune, my mother said in 1976

answers.why: make a fortune 意为“挣得一笔财富”，1965 年祖父挣得了一笔镇上没有一位职员肯清点的财富。
fortune 意为“财富”，指那一笔本身而不是运气，它经过了三个冬天而在簿子上没有被清点。
fortune 意为“财富”，指镇上每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一本短短的账簿。
fortune 意为“财富”，指留给孩子们的那一笔，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
fortune 意为“运气、机遇”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这次机遇就是那件事的全部。
fortune 意为“运气”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那笔财富，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
fortune 意为“财富”，指计划里写到、被清点过的那一笔，到 1972 年这一笔成了计划里的一行。
fortune 意为“财富”，祖父一月写道，整件事的聚财之事是一个镇子和三个冬天的清点。
fortune 意为“财富”，我记得的是计划里清点过的那一笔，1974 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一笔。
fortune 为抽象总称，母亲 1976 年说，一笔财富是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的东西。
